notes: Diagnostic, not added. Falling T&D losses lowered generation growth by about 0.144 log points over the window (so the trend may understate future generation if losses cannot keep falling); closing supply deficits raised it (so the trend may overstate). The net direction is not established from official figures alone. This is why t_and_d_losses is flagged as overlapping.
